type.description:
### ⚠️ Requires [Sync](https://modrinth.com/mod/sync) to be installed! ⚠️

Applies a visual disguise to a living entity, making it appear as a named player, even if that player is not currently online. Works alongside the [Disguised](../entity_condition_types/disguised.md) condition and [Remove Disguise](./remove_disguise.md) action.
type.markdownDescription:
### ⚠️ Requires [Sync](https://modrinth.com/mod/sync) to be installed! ⚠️

Applies a visual disguise to a living entity, making it appear as a named player, even if that player is not currently online. Works alongside the [Disguised](../entity_condition_types/disguised.md) condition and [Remove Disguise](./remove_disguise.md) action.

player_name.description: The name of the player to disguise as. Resolved via the server's user cache (the player must have joined this server at least once), used as a fallback if `player_uuid` is not present.
player_name.markdownDescription: The name of the player to disguise as. Resolved via the server's user cache (the player must have joined this server at least once), used as a fallback if `player_uuid` is not present.

player_uuid.description: The UUID of the player to disguise as. Takes priority over `player_name`, and does not require the player to have joined this server.
player_uuid.markdownDescription: The UUID of the player to disguise as. Takes priority over `player_name`, and does not require the player to have joined this server.

overwrite.description: If `false`, the action does nothing when the entity already has an active disguise.
overwrite.markdownDescription: If `false`, the action does nothing when the entity already has an active disguise.

before_action.description: Executed on the entity immediately before the disguise is applied.
before_action.markdownDescription: Executed on the entity immediately before the disguise is applied.

after_action.description: Executed on the entity immediately after the disguise is applied.
after_action.markdownDescription: Executed on the entity immediately after the disguise is applied.
